settings.title: Project Settings
settings.audioDeviceMoved: Output routing now lives in the mixer. Cues play through a bus, and each bus sends to a named output; which hardware that output means is configured on the server, so a show can move between venues unchanged.
settings.previewDeviceHelp: Device used when previewing cues with the headphones button.
settings.ltcDeviceHelp: Device used to send LTC timecode (optional).
settings.outputTargetHelp: Sets the brickwall limiter level, meter zone colours, waveform colours, and auto-volume target for this project.
settings.meterModeHelp: Unit shown on all stereo meters.
settings.meterBallisticsHelp: How fast the meters rise and fall.
settings.disableAutoVolumeAndTrim: Disable automatic volume and trim adjustments
settings.disableLimiterHelp: Turns off the brickwall limiter, allowing peaks above the output ceiling. Can be changed during playback.
settings.disableSilenceWarningHelp: Stops the silence warning banner from appearing in the header.
settings.transitionModeHelp: Transition applied to newly imported tracks. Each track can still be switched between cross-fade and start-next in its properties.
settings.autoCueNext: Automatically cue next item even without end behaviour
settings.autoCueNextHelp: Arms the next item as "Up Next" even when the playing item has no end behaviour, so you can step through the playlist with a single GO button. It does not start playback automatically.
settings.stopAllFadeHelp: How long all cues take to fade out when you press Stop All. Set to 0 for an instant stop.
settings.scrollToPlayingHelp: Automatically keep the currently-playing item centred in the list.
settings.indexDisplayStartHelp: Controls the number shown for the first playlist item. Internal indexes and API index paths remain zero-based.

properties.busHelp: Which bus this cue plays through. Where that bus goes — output, level, processing — is set in the mixer.
properties.busGroupHelp: Which bus this group's cues play through. A cue inside it follows this unless it sets its own.
properties.ltcOutputTimecodeHelp: Send SMPTE Linear Timecode to the project's LTC device while this cue plays.
properties.ltcRequiresDevice: Select an LTC output device in Project Settings to enable timecode output.
properties.multiSelectWaveform: Multiple items selected — choose a single item to display its waveform.
properties.multiSelectOutPointDisabled: Disabled for multiple selection (out point depends on each item's duration).

sessionRecovery.message: The connection is back, but the server no longer has a project open — it was most likely restarted. Your project is still here on this computer.
sessionRecovery.resumeHint: Continue session reopens this project on the server so you can carry on.
sessionRecovery.startFreshHint: Start fresh closes it and returns to the welcome screen.

mixer.title: Mixer
mixer.dockToMain: Dock back into the main window
mixer.empty: All cues route to Master. Add a bus to split your mix.
mixer.panHint: Where this mono bus sits between the two lanes of its destination. Constant power, so centre is -3 dB.
mixer.balanceHint: Trims this stereo bus's two lanes against each other. Only ever attenuates, so centre is unity.
mixer.widthHint: Stereo width. 1 leaves the image alone, 0 folds it to mono, 2 doubles it. The level rises with wide material — nothing compensates for it.
mixer.widthMonoOnly: A mono bus has no stereo image to widen
mixer.bassMonoHint: Sends everything below this to the centre, leaving the rest of the image alone. Parked at the bottom of its travel it is out of circuit.
mixer.correlationHint: How mono-compatible this bus is. +1 sums perfectly, 0 is wide, below 0 means part of it cancels when summed to mono.
mixer.shapeHint: Bell or shelf. A bell lifts a band and returns to flat either side of it; a shelf lifts everything past its corner and stays there.
mixer.qHint: How wide the bell is. Higher is narrower.
mixer.slopeHint: How steeply the shelf turns. 1 is as steep as it goes without peaking at the corner.
mixer.eqHandleHint: Drag for frequency and gain, wheel for Q, shift for fine, double-click to reset.
mixer.monoCheckHint: Fold the headphones to mono to check mono compatibility. PFL a bus first — anything that cancels when summed will drop out. The house is unaffected.
mixer.busRouteUnbound: This bus's route never reaches the master, so it is silent.
mixer.noStrip: This bus has no engine strip
mixer.pflHint: Pre-fade listen: send this bus to Monitor, before its fader and mute. The main output is unaffected.
mixer.monitorUnmapped: Monitor has no output on this machine, so PFL and cue pre-listen are silent. Map 'Monitor' in the output settings, or choose a preview device in project settings.
mixer.monitorHint: Monitor is the pre-listen bus: PFL from the mixer and cue previews both arrive here. This fader is your headphone level.
mixer.outputUnmapped: '{name}' is not mapped on this machine, so it is being treated as a device name.
mixer.outputMissingHint: Output missing — click to remap hardware
mixer.outputMapIntro: Logical output names used by this project's buses, and the hardware device and channel each one maps to on this machine.
mixer.outputMapDeleteConfirmBody: These buses target this output and will lose their hardware mapping:
mixer.auxSendsPending: Aux sends are a future feature — not implemented yet.
mixer.filterParked: Parked at the end of its travel — out of circuit. Turn it in, or double-click to park it again.
mixer.bypassHint: Take this section out of circuit. The settings are kept, so switching it back in restores exactly what was there.
mixer.gateToggle: Switch the expander/gate in or out. Separate from the section bypass above.
mixer.compToggle: Switch the compressor/limiter in or out. Separate from the section bypass above.

migration.title: This project was created before mixer buses.
migration.body: All cues now route to the Master bus.
migration.busesFromOverrides: {count} cues were moved onto buses created from their device overrides.
